# iL Progetto LLC

> Licensed mobile window treatment company serving San Diego County and Southern California. The designer brings the full showroom — fabric samples, hardware, motorization — to the client's home, measures every window, and delivers a same-visit quote. Free in-home consultation, custom fabrication, professional installation. California Contractors License #1127055. Phone (858) 338-1678 · info@progettoshades.com · Mon–Sat 8 AM–6 PM · Rated 5.0 from 32 published reviews.

Key facts: founded 2022; products are custom-measured and custom-made (roller, zebra, cellular, Roman, woven wood and sheer shades; wood, faux-wood, aluminum, vertical and panel-track blinds; plantation, café, door and arched shutters; blackout and sheer drapery; motorized interior and exterior shading, sun screens, awnings); smart-home integration with Alexa, Google Home, Apple HomeKit, Lutron and Control4; financing via Synchrony; 1-year full parts & labor warranty plus lifetime manufacturer warranty on mechanisms; service areas include San Diego, Poway, Carlsbad, La Jolla, Del Mar, Encinitas, Solana Beach, Rancho Santa Fe, Chula Vista, National City, Coronado, El Cajon, Escondido, San Marcos, Vista and Temecula.

## Products

- [Roller Shades](https://www.progettoshades.com/products/roller): blackout, light-filtering and sheer fabrics
- [Zebra Shades](https://www.progettoshades.com/products/zebra): alternating sheer/solid bands
- [Cellular Shades](https://www.progettoshades.com/products/cellular): honeycomb insulation, energy savings
- [Roman Shades](https://www.progettoshades.com/products/roman): tailored fabric folds
- [Motorized Shading](https://www.progettoshades.com/products/motorized): app, voice and scheduled control
- [Plantation Shutters](https://www.progettoshades.com/products/plantation): built-in, adds resale value
- [Blackout Curtains](https://www.progettoshades.com/products/blackout-curtains): triple-pass lining, custom drapery
- [Woven Wood Shades](https://www.progettoshades.com/products/woven-wood): bamboo, jute, sea grass
- [Sun Screens](https://www.progettoshades.com/products/sun-screens): 80–90% heat rejection with view
- [Awnings](https://www.progettoshades.com/products/awnings): retractable exterior shade
